By frame 4, an adult stands roughly 1–1.5 m in front and slightly right of the camera wearer, beside a blue chair and a white table, facing mostly left across the room with their head partly turned toward the camera. In frame 5, the same person is closer, about 0.5–1 m away and nearly centered, facing the camera wearer more directly; the camera wearer’s hand and forearm appear at the lower right within possible arm’s reach of the person. The person partly occludes the table and wall equipment behind them, while tall shelving and hanging equipment remain along the rear and right walls, and the sequence overall shows the camera turning right and approaching the person.
